definitions.name: terp_oracle_types_AggregateResponse
definitions.description: Prices for a set of pairs.

definitions.name: terp_oracle_types_PriceAsset
definitions.description: An asset priced by the oracle: a native/IBC/factory denom or a cw20 address.

alt_in_base.description: Base units (display) per 1 alt, whatever the feed direction.

max_deviation.description: Largest relative spread of a feed from `price`.

price.description: Combined value in the feed direction (`quote`).

alt_in_base.description:
Feed value = base units per 1 alt (in display units). E.g. feed
`ATOM/TERP = 12.5`, base TERP, alt ATOM: 1 ATOM costs 12.5 TERP.

base_in_alt.description: Feed value = alt units per 1 base (in display units).

definitions.name: terp_oracle_types_AggregateMethod
definitions.description: How several values are combined into one.

mean.description:
Weighted by `Feed::weight` (default 1) when combining feeds, and by
nothing when combining a history window.

weighted.description:
Weighted by observation count (`PricePoint::observations`) when combining feeds,
and by block gap (piecewise constant, like the registry TWAP) on a history window.

definitions.name: cosmwasm_std_math_decimal256_Decimal256
definitions.description:
A fixed-point decimal value with 18 fractional digits, i.e. Decimal256(1_000_000_000_000_000_000) == 1.0

The greatest possible value that can be represented is 115792089237316195423570985008687907853269984665640564039457.584007913129639935 = (2^256 - 1) / 10^18

height.description: Height of the newest observation, when the oracle exposes one.

observations.description: Observations behind this value (1 for spot).
